implementation.argument_surface: receiver in ECX (copied into ESI at 0x00f99981 and never moved back) and NO ordinary stack argument. The bare `RET` at 0x00f999d7 is machine-observed (byte C3, no immediate) and the frame balances to it: one PUSH ESI, one pushed word per call each popped by its own callee, one POP ESI on each of the two exits. Ghidra's own record reports 'undefined FUN_00f99980(void)' with ghidra_parameter_count 0, and its decompilation opens `void __fastcall FUN_00f99980(int param_1)` with param_1 standing for the ECX receiver; the listing is followed here.
implementation.return_type_note: This is option (b) of the wave-1 lesson on RETURN SEMANTICS, taken deliberately and with the argument stated. No instruction in the 25 has EAX as a destination, the only definitions of EAX are the three calls' own return words, and each of those is discarded (the manager's word becomes ECX at 0x00f9999d and nothing reads EAX again at 0x00f999a1, 0x00f999bc or anywhere else). The one path that does not return here (0x00f999d1) hands the return register to 0x00690120, which writes it itself. So the bytes produce no value. The canonical record disagrees in a way no C++ spelling can fix: abi_derived.abi.return_semantics is the machine phrase 'unclassified_in_EAX' and abi_derived.return carries register_class 'aggregate_unknown' with void_possible false. On the record's own terms that flag is not a claim that the function returns something -- tools/reconstruction_tooling/abi_infer.py sets void_possible only when EAX is never written AND the body contains no call, so no body with a call in it can have it set. No typedef named after the phrase is declared anywhere in this package; that would be a validator hack rather than a reconstruction. The dimension is therefore an unavoidable WARN and is reported as one.
implementation.receiver_model: a struct with NO named member at all. The machine-derived receiver record enumerates exactly two displacements (0x894 and 0x8a4, i.e. [2196, 2212]) with register ECX, shape R-ALIAS and bounds_only true, so it says where the body was seen reaching and not which member is which. The body therefore reaches the receiver through displacement-named accessors (word_at(self, kLightingTargetDisplacement) and word_at(self, kRefCountedDisplacement)) over an opaque 0x8a8-byte run, exactly as the wave-1 lesson requires for a bounds_only record. Calling the word at +0x8a4 a 'lighting target' and the word at +0x894 a 'reference count' would be a member story this body's evidence does not carry.
implementation.dispatch_model: one site, and it is modelled because the machine shows it: 0x00f99997 reads the manager's leading word and 0x00f99999 reads the word 0x7c into the table that word points at, which 0x00f9999f then calls. The model reaches the table through the MANAGER, never through the receiver, states the displacement 0x7c literally at the dispatch site, and types the slot as a thiscall function pointer -- the one typing that emits PUSH ECX / MOV ECX,EAX / CALL EDX in that order and that lets the callee own the one argument word, which the frame requires. No slot INDEX and no slot NAME are claimed beyond the receiver's own record; the record's association with the table at 0x01490be8 (this body is that table's slot +0x40) is recorded here and deliberately NOT modelled, because the body contains no read of the receiver's +0x00.
implementation.dependency_note: all three direct callees are declared extern in the package header and defined as observers in the package's own model test; no other package's header is included. 0x0067dd50, 0x00692400 and 0x00690120 are not owned by this package and this package asserts nothing about them beyond what their own instruction bytes fix (their terminators, their stack-argument shape and, for 0x00690120, the atomic decrement its own first six instructions perform).

observed_mechanics: 0x00f99981 MOV ESI,ECX -- the receiver is aliased into ESI and every receiver access in the body goes through that alias, which is why the machine-derived receiver record names register ECX with shape R-ALIAS

0x00f99983 CMP dword ptr [ESI+0x8a4],-0x1 with 0x00f9998a JZ 0x00f999a1 -- an exact 32-bit equality against 0xffffffff guards the whole dispatch; the merge point 0x00f999a1 is the instruction after the call, so the clear below it is unconditional
0x00f9998c CALL 0x0067dd50 -- the only source of the manager; the callee is six bytes in the image (A1 C0 D8 5F 01 / C3) and loads a .data word at 0x015fd8c0

0x00f99997 MOV EDX,[EAX] then 0x00f99999 MOV EDX,[EDX+0x7c] -- a two-level table load: the manager's leading word is a table POINTER and 0x7c (124 bytes, 31 whole dwords) is a byte displacement into that table
0x00f9999c PUSH ECX / 0x00f9999d MOV ECX,EAX / 0x00f9999f CALL EDX -- the receiver's +0x8a4 word is passed BY VALUE as the one stack argument and the manager becomes the ECX receiver

the indirect callee owns its one argument word: the body reaches 0x00f999d0 and 0x00f999d6 with a SINGLE POP ESI, and if the callee had left the pushed word there the POP would restore the argument instead of ESI and the RET would branch to it
0x00f999a1 reads the receiver's +0x894 word and 0x00f999a7 stores 0xffffffff into +0x8a4, in that order, on every path
0x00f999b1/0x00f999b3 test that first +0x894 word against zero and 0x00f999b5/0x00f999b7 push the literal 1 and call 0x00692400 with that word as the ECX receiver
0x00f999bc reads the +0x894 word AGAIN, after the call: the re-read is a real second read, and 0x00f999c2/0x00f999c4 test that second value

0x00f999c6 stores 0 into +0x894 and 0x00f999d0 pops ESI before 0x00f999d1 jumps to 0x00690120, so the transfer is a tail call whose receiver is the word read at 0x00f999bc and not the zero just stored

0x00692400's own bytes fix the notify's shape: TEST ECX,ECX / JE (a null adjustor), MOV EDX,[ESP+0x4] (the one stack word), LEA EAX,[ECX-0x8] (the receiver adjusted), a table read at +0x30, and RET 0x4 at both 0x00692417 and 0x0069242c, so the callee owns the argument word

0x00690120's own bytes fix the release's shape: TEST ECX,ECX / JE, LEA EAX,[ECX-0x8], ADD EAX,0x4c, OR ESI,0xffffffff, LOCK XADD [EAX],ESI, DEC ESI, JNE -- one atomic decrement of a word 0x4c bytes into the adjusted receiver -- and a plain RET, so it takes no stack argument
no instruction in the 25 has EAX as a destination, so the four paths to 0x00f999d7 leave four different dead words there and the body produces no value

the complete 25-instruction listing names no data-segment address, and the class table whose slot +0x40 this body occupies is at 0x01490be8 (read out of the image: the word at 0x01490c28 is 0x00f99980, and the single xref into this body comes from 0x01490c28)

observed_original_abi.return_type: void (declared); the machine-derived record's own claim is the phrase 'unclassified_in_EAX' -- see implementation.return_type_note for why the two cannot be reconciled by any C++ spelling

observed_original_abi.ghidra_convention_note: The decompilation of this VA opens `void __fastcall FUN_00f99980(int param_1)` and calls the manager's slot through `(*pIVar1->_vftable0[2].GetLightingWorld)`. Neither is followed where it disagrees with the listing. (1) `__fastcall` versus `__thiscall`: the frame carries no stack argument at all (a bare RET, one PUSH ESI, one POP ESI on each exit), so there is no EDX argument register to be fastcall's. (3) The decompilation writes the notify as `FUN_00692400(1)` and the release as `FUN_00690120()`, i.e. with no receiver, which is the decompiler treating the ECX value as a local; the listing moves the +0x894 word into ECX at 0x00f999a1 and 0x00f999bc and never overwrites it before either call, and both callees' own first instruction is TEST ECX,ECX.

observed_original_abi.callee_conventions: each fixed by the callee's own bytes, read from the image with objdump: 0x0067dd50 is `A1 C0 D8 5F 01 / C3`, so cdecl with no argument; 0x00692400 ends `C2 04 00` at both of its return sites, so callee-owned cleanup of one stack word; 0x00690120 reads no stack slot and ends `C3`, so it takes only the ECX receiver. The INDIRECT callee's cleanup is a frame fact rather than a terminator fact, and it is the same __thiscall typing the model uses.
observed_original_abi.evidence_level: ABI_INFERRED in substance but recorded as ABI_UNKNOWN: abi_derived.verdict is ABI_UNKNOWN and completeness is PARTIAL, with abstained_because ['flow_not_modelled: the linear ESP walk ends at +4, so the listing is not one path']. conventions.calling_convention is __thiscall with candidates [__thiscall, __fastcall] and confidence INFERRED; the record itself explains the abstention -- the listing has two exits through 0x00f999d6 and one of them is preceded by a call whose stack effect the linear walker cannot attribute without a per-path model, which this package supplies by hand (see mechanics.frame_resolution). That is a statement about the record's coverage, and the model test's two trampolines measure the frame directly rather than inheriting the abstention.

mechanics.body_shape: if the receiver's word at +0x8a4 is not the 0xffffffff sentinel, obtain the lighting manager, read the table word 0x7c into the manager's table and call it with the manager as the receiver and the +0x8a4 word as the one argument; then store 0xffffffff into +0x8a4 unconditionally; then, if the word at +0x894 is non-null, call through it with the argument 1, re-read +0x894, and if it is still non-null, store 0 into it and transfer control to 0x00690120 with that re-read word still in ECX

frame_resolution.method: one walk of ESP through all 25 instructions, using each callee's own terminator to settle the stack after every call. Entry ESP is 0. 0x00f99980 pushes ESI (entry-4). The indirect callee pops the word pushed at 0x00f9999c; 0x00692400 ends RET 0x4 and pops the word pushed at 0x00f999b5; 0x0067dd50 pushes nothing. Every path therefore returns to entry-4, and 0x00f999d0 and 0x00f999d6 each POP back to entry before the RET or the tail transfer.
frame_resolution.corroboration: three independent agreements. (1) There is exactly one POP ESI on each of the two exits and no ADD ESP anywhere in the 25 instructions, so the only way either exit reaches its return address with a balanced stack is if both popping callees popped their own word. (2) The terminator is the byte C3 with no immediate, which is what a zero-argument callee-cleaned frame requires. (3) The model test's two trampolines measure it: ESP is sampled before and after a call into the reconstructed function and the two are equal, and the same is done for a one-word push into the notify callee.

slots.entry+4: the return address, consumed by the RET at 0x00f999d7 or by the tail transfer at 0x00f999d1
slots.entry-4: the saved ESI, pushed at 0x00f99980 and popped at 0x00f999d0 or 0x00f999d6

frame_resolution.tail_call: 0x00f999d1 is `JMP 0x00690120` after the POP ESI, so the transfer inherits the entry stack exactly and 0x00690120 returns to THIS body's caller with nothing of this frame left. The model writes it as `return owned_object_release_00690120(owned_after);` because that is the same transfer expressed in C++; nothing outside the body can distinguish the two shapes and the emitted code for this package is call+ret, which is recorded rather than claimed as a jump.

receiver_displacement.0x8a4: compared against 0xffffffff at 0x00f99983, read into ECX at 0x00f99991 as the dispatch's one argument, and written with 0xffffffff at 0x00f999a7. It is the ONLY write this body makes there, and that write is unconditional: 0x00f999a7 is the first instruction at the merge point 0x00f999a1, so it runs on the sentinel path and on the path where the trailing guards fail.
receiver_displacement.0x894: read at 0x00f999a1 and tested at 0x00f999b1; read AGAIN at 0x00f999bc after the 0x00692400 call and tested again at 0x00f999c2; written with 0 at 0x00f999c6. The second read is the one that decides both whether the field is cleared and which word the transfer carries.
receiver_displacement.note: The two are read in that order and both are fixed twice over: by the listing's own operands, and by the machine-derived receiver record, whose offsets are [2196, 2212] = [0x894, 0x8a4] with bounds_only true. Nothing in 0x00..0x893 or 0x8a8 onward is read or written by this body, and no member is named for either word.

mechanics.control_flow: three conditional branches, all with absolute targets inside the recovered body span 0x00f99980..0x00f999d7: JZ 0x00f999a1 (0x00f9998a, the sentinel test), JZ 0x00f999d6 (0x00f999b3, the first null test) and JZ 0x00f999d6 (0x00f999c4, the second null test). Plus one unconditional transfer out of the body, JMP 0x00690120 at 0x00f999d1, which is a tail call rather than intra-procedural control flow, so the CALLS check counts it as a transfer target -- and the xref export agrees, recording an out-edge for it.
mechanics.ordering: the four orderings the model reproduces and the model test measures from inside the callees: (1) the dispatch at 0x00f9999f runs BEFORE the clear of +0x8a4 at 0x00f999a7, so the slot call still sees the old value in memory; (2) the clear runs BEFORE the notify at 0x00f999b7; (3) the notify's re-read at 0x00f999bc happens AFTER the call, so a callee that writes the field changes the outcome; (4) the clear at 0x00f999c6 runs BEFORE the transfer at 0x00f999d1, and the word the transfer carries is the one read at 0x00f999bc, not the zero just stored.
mechanics.globals: none. The complete 25-instruction listing names no data-segment address and the source span names none either (its entire hexadecimal-literal set, comments excluded, is the single 0x7c of the dispatch). The .data word 0x015fd8c0 belongs to 0x0067dd50's own body -- its first instruction is `MOV EAX,ds:0x015fd8c0` -- and is deliberately not modelled as a global here, because the model reaches the manager only through that call's return value, which is what the machine does.

mechanics.return_semantics_machine: no value is produced. The only outputs are the two receiver stores: +0x8a4 to 0xffffffff and, on the trailing arm, +0x894 to 0. EAX is dead at 0x00f999d7 and holds one of four different words depending on the path: the caller's own incoming word (sentinel set, +0x894 null), the slot's return word (dispatch ran, +0x894 null), 0x00692400's return word (both words live, second guard taken), and -- on the transfer path -- whatever 0x00690120 writes, which its own bytes make 0 when the count reaches zero. Nothing is modelled for EAX and the model test asserts nothing about it.

return_semantics.value: no value is produced by this body. The observable effect is entirely in the receiver's two words: +0x8a4 is set to the 0xffffffff sentinel, and on the trailing arm +0x894 is set to 0 before the reference is transferred away.
return_semantics.ownership: The body performs no reference acquisition of its own. It reads a pointer from the receiver, hands it to a callee as a receiver and hands a second one to a callee as an argument. That 0x00690120's own bytes decrement a counter at the adjusted receiver's +0x4c is recorded as a description of that callee; whether the +0x894 word is an owning or a borrowed reference is NOT established by any record for this target and is not claimed.
return_semantics.lifetime: the two words are the only objects the body names, and neither is copied: the dispatch receives the +0x8a4 value by value and the transfer receives the +0x894 value in ECX. Both pointees outlive the call in the only sense that matters here -- the body never dereferences either, and it writes to neither object, only to its own receiver's two words.

The decompilation agrees with the listing on the two stores, on both null tests and on the order of the whole body.

unresolved_questions: The canonical ABI record cannot be reconciled with any C++ return type, and this package does not try. abi_derived.abi.return_semantics is the machine phrase 'unclassified_in_EAX' and the validator compares the declared return type against it as a string, so RETURN SEMANTICS is a WARN whatever is written. The choice made here is (b) of the wave-1 lesson -- declare void -- and the argument for it is in implementation.return_type_note: no instruction in the 25 has EAX as a destination and all three calls' return words are discarded. The alternative (a), a 32-bit integral return, would be a positive claim that this body produces a value, which the bytes refute. The record's void_possible false is not a counter-argument: abi_infer.py sets that flag only when EAX is never written AND the body contains no call, so it is unset for every body with a call in it, whatever the body returns. No typedef named after the phrase exists in this package.

ABI is WARN, and it is fixed rather than fixable from this package: the derived record's verdict is ABI_UNKNOWN because the inference's linear ESP walk ended at +4 on a listing that is not one path, and the record states that reason itself. The model here supplies the per-path frame the walker could not (mechanics.frame_resolution), and the model test measures the frame with two ESP-sampling trampolines, but the verdict is read out of the committed record and no source edit can move it.

What the two receiver words ARE is not established. The +0x8a4 word is compared against 0xffffffff, passed by value to a lighting-manager method and then overwritten with 0xffffffff; the +0x894 word is null-tested, used as an ECX receiver by a thunk that adjusts it by -8 and dispatches through its table at +0x30, and finally cleared and handed to 0x00690120. That is what the bytes do, and nothing here says what either word is for: no record in this repository names them, no caller of this body exists in the xref export, and a sibling listing in the same class was not read for this package. Naming them is deliberately left to the integrator.

Whether the +0x8a4 word is an owning reference, a borrowed one, or an index is unknown. The body stores 0xffffffff over it and hands its value to a method that this body never sees inside, so the ownership question cannot be settled from here. The one fact that leans on it is 0x00690120's own `LOCK XADD [EAX],ESI` with ESI = -1, and that is about the OTHER word.

What the literal 1 pushed at 0x00f999b5 means is not established. 0x00692400 reads it as its own first stack word and forwards it to 0x00692330, whose body was not read for this package. It is passed as 1 because that is what the PUSH carries, and nothing more is claimed.

What 0x00692330 is, and what 0x00690120 does after its branch at 0x00690137, were not read. The first is the notify's target and the second is the arm taken when the count does not reach zero. Both are outside this body, and the model asserts nothing about either.

Whether the slot at 0x7c is a real slot INDEX in any class is not established. 0x7c is 31 whole dwords, which is what a dword-indexed table looks like on x86-32, and the machine's own classifier reads the site as VTABLE_SLOT -- but no record names the class, no record names the method, and the decompiler's `_vftable0[2].GetLightingWorld` is a structure it applied itself, not evidence. The model states the displacement and the receiver and the argument and nothing more.

The model's emitted code for the transfer at 0x00f999d1 is call+ret rather than the machine's jmp, because no C++ spelling forces the jump and this function needs a frame for the position-independent thunk. Nothing outside the body can distinguish the two shapes -- the callee's return reaches the body's caller either way, and no memory of the body is touched after the transfer -- so case T of the model test asserts the observable consequences (a balanced frame, and the callee receiving the word read before the clear) and the machine's JMP is recorded here rather than claimed. See validation.mutation_checking for the mutation that survives for this reason.

The unconditional clear of +0x8a4 at 0x00f999a7 cannot be distinguished from a conditional one, and this is provable rather than a gap in the test: on the only path where the two differ the field already holds 0xffffffff, so storing 0xffffffff over it changes no byte. The model test asserts the stronger observable instead (case A: with the sentinel already in place, not one byte of the receiver changes). The mutation that makes the clear conditional survives, and no input can kill it.

conditions: The original process reaches this body with the receiver's +0x8a4 word both equal to 0xffffffff and different from it, and with the receiver's +0x894 word both null and non-null.

A trace records, for the +0x8a4 non-sentinel case, the value the manager's getter returned, the address the table word at 0x7c was read from, and the two arguments the dispatched method received, in order.
A trace records whether the +0x894 word changes across the 0x00692400 call, which is the only way to settle whether that re-read is load-bearing in the original process or merely defensive.

A trace captures the word handed to 0x00690120 in ECX and the value of the receiver's +0x894 word at that instant, to confirm the ordering this package derives from the byte order (clear first, transfer of the previously read word second).

The word left in EAX on each of the four paths is compared against the reconstruction's declared void return, and the four dead compositions in mechanics.return_semantics_machine are confirmed to be unobservable to any caller.

validation.model_test: plain int main() with explicit checks, no framework and no external dependency. The three direct callees are defined in the test as observers. The dispatched slot is PLANTED, not hard-coded: the fake manager's leading word points at a fake table whose word at +0x7c is the test's slot observer and every other word of BOTH objects is a distinct decoy slot, so a wrong base object, a wrong slot and a byte-versus-index reading of the displacement are all reported rather than merely wrong. The notify observer may write the receiver's +0x894, which is the only way to test the re-read at 0x00f999bc; the release and the slot observers sample the receiver at the moment of the call, which is the only way to test the ordering. The receiver is pre-filled with a pattern and compared byte by byte afterwards, so 'nothing else moved' is asserted rather than assumed. Two inline-asm trampolines sample ESP on both sides of a call into the reconstructed body and of a one-word push into the notify callee, so the stack cleanup is measured. Cases: A nothing to do; B dispatch then clear; C the full run with all four transfers; D the notify clears the field; E the notify replaces the field; F the exactness of the sentinel test, driven with 0x00000000, 0x7fffffff, 0x80000000 and 0xfffffffe; G six decoy words around the receiver's two; H the +0x8a4 word passed by value; I/J the two-level load and the byte displacement; K the transfer after the clear; L a second call on the receiver the first call left behind; M the measured stack cleanup; N the two guards taken independently in both directions; T the tail arm leaves the frame balanced and the receiver fully updated; V the machine constants.

expected_reasons.CALLS: PASS. The two machine oracles agree: the xref export carries exactly three outgoing direct-call rows (0x00f9998c -> 0x0067dd50, 0x00f999b7 -> 0x00692400, 0x00f999d1 -> 0x00690120) and the complete 25-instruction listing has exactly three direct transfers, the third being the tail jump, which DIRECT_TRANSFER reads as well as CALL because MSVC compiles a tail call as a jump. No intra-procedural jump is filtered because none of the three targets is inside the span. The complete 25-instruction listing names no data-segment address -- the three absolute operands in it are all code addresses below 0x01300000 -- and the source span names none either. No struct member is named anywhere in the span -- every receiver access is a displacement-named accessor over an opaque byte run -- so there is no uncorroborated identity to warn about. The alias-aware scan of the complete listing, which follows MOV ESI,ECX at 0x00f99981, attributes exactly two displacements to the receiver as proven (0x894 and 0x8a4) and the machine-derived record enumerates exactly those two, so the pair is fixed by two independent witnesses. The span was additionally audited with the validator's own extractor over the WHOLE .cpp and over the whole header, and the .cpp presents none at all and the header presents only {0x7c, 0x894, 0x8a4, 0xffffffff}, every one of which is in the listing. The receiver's size is written as a derived expression rather than as a literal for exactly this reason.
expected_reasons.CONTROL FLOW: PASS. All three conditional branch targets in the complete listing lie inside the recovered body span 0x00f99980..0x00f999d7 -- 0x00f999a1 and 0x00f999d6 twice -- so the branch graph closes inside it. The unconditional JMP at 0x00f999d1 leaves the body, but that is a tail call counted by CALLS, not a conditional branch. The span declares if; keyword shape is explicitly not part of the verdict.
expected_reasons.VIRTUAL DISPATCH: PASS, and this is a positively-corroborated pass rather than an absence: the body names one indirect transfer and the machine proves it. The listing's two-level load at 0x00f99997/0x00f99999 classifies as VTABLE_SLOT with slot_offset 124, the machine dispatch record independently counts 1 and agrees, and the parse record shows 25 of 25 instructions consumed with 0 unparsed and degraded false.
